description: This file defines types, constants, and a function to fetch message history from the BlueBubbles API, including handling different response structures and limiting message data.

methods.name: resolveAccount
methods.description: Resolves server account details using provided options.

methods.name: clampHistoryLimit
methods.description: Ensures the message fetch limit is within allowed bounds.

methods.name: truncateHistoryBody
methods.description: Truncates message body text to a maximum length with ellipsis.

methods.name: fetchBlueBubblesHistory
methods.description: Fetches message history from BlueBubbles API for a specific chat, trying multiple API endpoints and handling different response formats.
